definitions.explanation: A large bell, especially those in temples or churches.

examples.japanese: {除夜|じょや}の{鐘|かね}を{聞|き}く。
examples.english: To listen to the New Year's Eve bell.

notes:
{鐘|かね} refers to large bells, especially temple bells.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {鐘|かね}が{鳴|な}る (the bell rings)
- {鐘|かね}を{突|つ}く/{撞|つ}く (to strike a bell)
- {鐘|かね}の{音|ね} (the sound of the bell)

CULTURAL NOTES:
- {除夜|じょや}の{鐘|かね} (New Year's Eve bell - rung 108 times)
- Temple bells ({梵鐘|ぼんしょう}) are important in Buddhism

HOMOPHONE:
- {金|かね} (money) - different kanji

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {鐘|かね}: large bell (temple, church)
- ベル: bell (small, electric)
- {鈴|すず}: small bell, jingle bell
